name: Harness
summary: The Harness platform sells CI and CD on one platform with a Free plan priced at $0. Essentials and Enterprise are quote only, and the pricing page publishes no per-developer price. Essentials caps users at 500 and keeps 6 months of pipeline execution history.

facts.text: Essentials allows up to 500 users, 60 concurrent CI executions and 60 concurrent CD executions. Enterprise allows unlimited CI executions and up to 500 concurrent CD executions.
Pipeline execution history is kept for 6 months on Essentials, and 25 months on Enterprise as an add-on.
On the pricing page, no build minute limits and no limits are listed for the Free plan.
Execution logs can be downloaded from the UI or through the Log Service API as a logs.zip of NDJSON files.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Community support. Limits are not listed on the pricing page

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Priced by quotation. Up to 500 users

hiddenCosts: No paid price is published, so a buyer has to ask sales for a quote.
A 25-month execution history on Enterprise is an add-on.
